meta.publishedConvention: published = date of the company's covering letter to BSE/NSE on page 1 of each filing (filing date).
meta.actualsNote: Actual EBITDA for missPct uses the Screener consolidated figures supplied by the caller (FY22 1,720; FY23 1,089; FY24 978; FY25 997; FY26 1,168). meta.quoteNote: Every 'quote' field is a direct quote under 25 words. Everything else is paraphrase.

energyBusiness.what: Mostly MMA (monomethyl aniline, an aniline derivative; also called N-methyl aniline) sold as a high-octane gasoline additive to blenders and refineries, plus calcium chloride. Uses: cargo blending of gasoline grades, upgrading naphtha/gasoline cuts, refinery optimisation. Octane number 400+ vs ~90 for gasoline; blended at below 1-2%. Priced at ~1.8-2x MTBE. Global MMA capacity is well under 1 mn t vs >30 mn t for MTBE. It is not a fuel-trading business and not methyl methacrylate.
energyBusiness.whenStarted: Small (~15% of revenue) in FY22. Management: 'not part of our portfolio in a significant way, let's say two years back' (said Aug-2024). Scaled up in FY24 under the 4-year Rs 6,000 cr+ contract (LTC-5, Jan-2024; supplies of ~750 cr in FY23 and ~900 cr in FY24 to that customer).
energyBusiness.capacityAndVolume: Capacity ~200 KTPA (Nov-24), ~260 (Q1FY26), 290+ (Q3FY26), target ~360 KT by Q4FY26. Production FY25 123 kt; Q2FY26 63.5 kt; Q3FY26 69.0 kt (96% utilisation). July-2025 exports ~20-22 kt.
energyBusiness.marginProfile: Not disclosed. Pricing tracks aniline (raw material; 1.5-2 months of imported inventory carried, so price risk) and demand tracks the gasoline-naphtha and gasoline-crude cracks. Viable while the gasoline-naphtha spread stays in double digits (it was ~9.5 in Q3FY25). The LTC-5 margin was guided at 15-17% at constant prices. Volatile and seasonal: a 36% QoQ volume drop in Q2FY25 led to the FY25 guidance being dropped. Competition from Chinese and Indian players; pricing calls taken to keep share. US tariffs apply in full.
energyBusiness.strategy: Diversify from a Middle East-heavy customer base to the US, Europe, Singapore and Africa; bulk-shipment capability; move from 2-3 refineries to 15-20; a 'solution' (blending know-how) sales approach.

Demerger share-entitlement ratio; any bonus issue (e.g., 1:1 in 2021), stock split, QIP (amount/price/date), stake sales to funds or buyback: none mentioned in the transcripts/presentations read. Needs annual reports or exchange filings.
